parameters.content:
## Fiverr Gig & Seller Sitemap Directory Scraper

**Actor:** [Fiverr Gig & Seller Sitemap Directory Scraper](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/fiverr-gig-and-seller-sitemap-directory-scraper)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/fiverr-gig-and-seller-sitemap-directory-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `searchQueries` (array)
- `searchUrls` (array)
- `gigUrls` (array)
- `sellerUrls` (array)
- `sitemapType` (string)
- `searchKeyword` (string)
- `maxShards` (integer)
- `categoryLevel` (string)
- `ideaType` (string)
- `category` (string)
- `sortBy` (string)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `gigUrl` (Gig Url)
- `sellerUsername` (Seller Username)
- `sellerLevel` (Seller Level)
- `category` (Category)
- `subCategory` (Sub Category)
- `priceMin` (Price Min)
- `priceMax` (Price Max)
- `currency` (Currency)
- `rating` (Rating)
- `reviewsCount` (Reviews Count)
- `sellerCountryCode` (Seller Country Code)

description: Fiverr gig scraper: runs the Fiverr Gig & Seller Sitemap Directory Scraper Apify Actor, returns title, gigUrl, priceMin, priceMax, rating and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
